messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "complications may require longer hospital stay"
set: ["complications may require longer hospital stay", "complications may require breathing support", "complications may require tube feeding", "newborn problems requiring longer hospital stays", "may cause complications during pregnancy", "lower risk of hospital admission and living longer", "diabetes complications", "hospital stays", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may cause serious medical complications in baby", "other heart complications", "diabetic retinopathy complications", "may require dose adjustment if coadministered with CYP2B6 inhibitors", "lasts longer", "hospital or clinic settings", "intravenous injection in hospital"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
